recurrent seizures

Smc3 deletion downregulates key genes including Ets2 in OFT cardiac muscle cells
Decreased super-enhancer–promoter interactions
Ets2-SE-null mice show delayed OFT development

model_organism.citation: Cohesin protein Smc3 influences kinocilial structure and function (PMID: 41263044)
phenotypes: Reduced kinociliary length in posterior lateral line neuromast hair cells
Neomycin resistance of neuromasts, suggesting impaired kinocilium function
Normal FM1-43X uptake (mechanotransduction not affected)
Reduced hair cell number within neuromasts

model_organism.citation: Horsfield et al. 2007 - Cohesin-dependent regulation of Runx genes (PMID: 17567667)
phenotypes: Embryos lacking Smc3 (or Rad21) fail to express runx3
Loss of hematopoietic runx1 expression in early embryonic development
Gene expression changes occurred while cell division could still proceed, suggesting a transcriptional role of cohesin separable from its mitotic role

phenotypes: Homozygous Smc3 deletion abrogated germinal center formation
Smc3 haploinsufficiency caused GC hyperplasia, skewed GC polarity, and impaired plasma cell differentiation
Impaired enhancer connectivity at lymphoma tumor suppressor genes (Tet2, Kmt2d)
Smc3 haploinsufficiency accelerated lymphomagenesis in mice with constitutive Bcl6 expression

model_organism.citation: Cohesin Core Complex Gene Dosage Contributes to Germinal Center Derived Lymphoma Phenotypes and Outcomes (PMID: 34621263)
phenotypes: Smc3 haploinsufficient GC B-cell lymphomas show downregulation of Tet2/Kmt2d-repressed genes
Impaired enhancer-promoter interactions with aberrant Tet2 downregulation
Defect in commitment to final steps of plasma cell differentiation
Structural abnormalities in GC B-cells without increased somatic mutations or structural variants

biological.citation: SMC3 contributes to heart development by regulating super-enhancer associated genes (PMID: 39085358)
biological.summary: Heart-specific Smc3 knockout mice show outflow tract abnormalities. Smc3 deletion reduces super-enhancer–promoter interactions and downregulates key genes such as Ets2 in OFT cardiac muscle cells. CdLS patients with SMC3 mutations have high rates of CHD, and 16 rare potentially pathogenic SMC3 variants were found in isolated CHD.
biological.sample_size: 16 rare SMC3 variants in isolated CHD cases; SMC3-cKO mice

biological.citation: Heterozygous loss-of-function SMC3 variants are associated with variable growth and developmental features (PMID: 38297832)
biological.summary: SMC3 is highly constrained against pLoF variants and depleted for missense variants, behaving as a haploinsufficient gene. Fourteen pLoF carriers show a milder, variable atypical CdLS-like phenotype with incomplete penetrance. pLoF variants reduce SMC3 expression but do not cluster with the CdLS epigenetic signature.

biological.citation: Smc3 dosage regulates B cell transit through germinal centers and restricts their malignant transformation (PMID: 33432228)
biological.summary: Homozygous Smc3 deletion abolishes germinal center formation, whereas haploinsufficiency causes GC hyperplasia and impaired plasma cell differentiation. Haploinsufficiency impairs enhancer connectivity at lymphoma tumor suppressor genes (Tet2, Kmt2d) and accelerates Bcl6-driven lymphomagenesis in mice.

biological.citation: ASHG 2012 - Dysregulated pathways in Cornelia de Lange syndrome cells mutated in core cohesin genes
biological.summary: Proteomic profiling of CdLS patient cell lines with SMC1A or SMC3 mutations showed dysregulated proteins in metabolism, cytoskeleton organization, antioxidant response and RNA processing. c-MYC lies at the hub of these pathways and is down-regulated in the mutant lines.
Zebrafish embryos lacking Smc3 or Rad21 fail to express runx3 and lose hematopoietic runx1 expression. This supports a transcriptional role for cohesin that is separable from its mitotic role.

Variants in SMC3 and RAD21 were found in four individuals with holoprosencephaly. Cohesin as a whole is implicated in midline forebrain development, and knockdown of STAG2 and SMC1A dysregulates HPE genes in human neural stem cells.

biological.citation: Genetic determinants of micronucleus formation in vivo (PMID: 38355793)
biological.summary: In a CRISPR screen of DSCC1 loss in human cells, SIRT1 loss rescued the micronucleus and cohesinopathy-like phenotypes. The rescue paralleled restoration of SMC3 acetylation, linking SMC3 acetylation status to genomic stability.

biological.citation: Sororin actively maintains sister chromatid cohesion (PMID: 26903600)
biological.summary: ESCO1 and ESCO2 stabilize cohesin on chromatin solely by acetylating SMC3. Sororin acts through this acetylation by inhibiting WAPL and interacts dynamically with the cohesin it stabilizes.

biological.citation: Cell cycle control of cohesion establishment (PMID: 41694619)
biological.summary: Cohesion establishment requires SMC3 modification by the ESCO2 acetyltransferase. CDK phosphorylation of ESCO2 at serine 75 controls its interaction with the replication machinery and its ability to ensure cohesion.

biological.citation: Cohesin reconstitution and homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks in late mitosis (PMID: 41216968)
biological.summary: In yeast, after an HO-induced DSB in telophase, Scc1 returns and partially reconstitutes a chromatin-bound cohesin complex with Smc1 and an acetylated pool of Smc3. This new cohesin is not required for HR-driven MAT switching.
